name: relationship
description: Cross-sell commitments: realisation of committed ancillary income for relationship RAROC (uncommitted lines use returns.ancillary_realisation). Round D: deposit_requirement prices required operating balances (the Deposit requirement term) into relationship RAROC.
source: Corporate Banking relationship P&L 2025: realised share of committed and uncommitted cross-sell

deposit_requirement.basis: Required operating balances on current accounts pay no profit; they earn the Treasury FTP credit for stable deposits (uae_desk.deposit_ftp_credit) and are realised at relationship.committed_realisation, as a committed cross-sell line. max_pct bounds the requirement as a % of the limit.
